hack.root_cause: Mis-ordered Parameters in burnFrom — Public Approval Override
hack.description: Deus DAO's third hack in two years came from a mis-ordered parameter in the `burnFrom` function of a token upgrade, allowing anyone to seize approval over DEI holders' balances and drain $6.5M across three chains.
